## github.com/posthog/posthog-go/v2/ai/evaluations

package evaluations // import "github.com/posthog/posthog-go/v2/ai/evaluations"

Package evaluations manages AI datasets, scorer definitions, and offline
experiments through the acknowledged PostHog project API.

Set Config.SecretKey to a project secret API key for the configured project or
a personal API key. Dataset and scorer management use dataset and llm_analytics
scopes respectively. A key with offline_evaluation_ingestion:write can create
runs, submit outcomes and close runs using previously saved dataset and scorer
version IDs. All network calls take a context and return after acknowledgment.
Use errors.As to inspect an APIError or recover the unfinished portion of a
BulkError.

The client reads up to 128 MiB for a successful list page and 4 MiB for other
responses. If a page exceeds the limit, request a smaller page.

## github.com/posthog/posthog-go/v2/extras

package extras // import "github.com/posthog/posthog-go/v2/extras"


## github.com/posthog/posthog-go/v2/posthogmcp

package posthogmcp // import "github.com/posthog/posthog-go/v2/posthogmcp"

Package posthogmcp builds and enqueues canonical PostHog analytics events for
Model Context Protocol activity without depending on a particular MCP framework.

Applications own the PostHog client lifecycle and pass completed tool
calls to Analytics. Tool parameters, responses, intent, and error messages
are sanitized and bounded before they are queued. A call that names an
unregistered tool, an input_required round the client receives, and a report
of a missing capability, are not tool calls: Analytics.CaptureUnknownTool,
Analytics.CaptureInputRequired, and Analytics.CaptureMissingCapability send
their own events. Parameter or response JSON exceeding 1 MiB after media
redaction is replaced with an omission marker.

MCP events carry $lib posthog-go-mcp and $lib_version set to the SDK version.
ToolCall.Properties, the EventContext's Properties and the request context's
properties can set either one, key by key like other properties, so set both
together. A $lib that is not a non-empty string gets the MCP pair. BeforeSend
can change either.

FUNCTIONS

func TransportSessionID(id string) string

func WithCallContext(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, source SessionSource, distinctID string) context.Context
